title: A single anchor-free step
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a control state, and let $c,d$ be configurations. If one step of $M$ carries $c$ to $d$ and neither configuration has state $a$, then the run from $c$ after one step is $d$ and avoids $a$ at times $0$ and $1$.
replaced:
If one machine step carries $c$ to $d$ and neither $c$ nor $d$ is in the
anchor state, then the one-step run from $c$ ends at $d$ and is anchor-free.
